### int-hdr-current-vs-rail

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-hdr-current-vs-rail" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-hdr-2541wr-2x08p-c5383092` (this record)
- **Conditions:** worst-case single-contact 3.0A rating vs the project's +12V/1.2A, +5V/0.5A, -12V/0.8A rail budgets (pins 7-8, 5-6, 15-16) gives large nominal margin even ignoring the second parallel pin in each pair, but the rating is UNSOURCED at primary-manufacturer level and comes from a generic-position-count drawing; contact resistance and thermal rise under sustained rail current needs a bench check
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

## Legend

What the recorded terms on this page mean, in ordinary words. The exact terms above are the ones that count; these descriptions explain them and never replace them.

### Verdict

| Recorded term                           | What it means                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CONFIRMED - distributor identity only` | A distributor listing confirms which part this is, and nothing more. It carries no electrical, thermal or lifetime authority. |
| `NEEDS BENCH`                           | Cannot be settled from documents. It needs measurement on real hardware before it can be relied on.                           |
| `UNSOURCED`                             | No accepted source backs this value yet. Treat it as a claim, not a fact.                                                     |

### Provenance

| Recorded term          | What it means                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CALCULATED`           | Derived arithmetically from other facts listed here. The expression and every input are shown, so the number can be recomputed rather than trusted. |
| `DISTRIBUTOR-IDENTITY` | Taken from a distributor listing. Identity information only.                                                                                        |
| `PROJECT-CHOICE`       | A decision made by this project. No vendor asserts it.                                                                                              |
| `UNVERIFIED`           | Recorded, but not yet backed by an accepted source.                                                                                                 |

### Fact class

| Recorded term           | What it means                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `PROJECT_STATE`         | A value this project recorded about how the part is used here — a chosen operating point, a net assignment, or a derived figure. Not a manufacturer specification. |
| `PROTECTION_BREAKDOWN`  | The voltage at which a protection device begins to conduct.                                                                                                        |
| `RECOMMENDED_OPERATION` | The range the manufacturer intends the part to be used in. Always narrower than the absolute maximum.                                                              |

### Coverage status

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `COVERED`     | Every question this domain asks is answered by the facts listed against it.                                                 |
| `OPEN`        | Unresolved. Open means the question has not been answered, not that the part is unsafe — the reason states what is missing. |

### Source availability

| Recorded term | What it means                                |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `AVAILABLE`   | The document was retrieved and is on record. |

### Source authority

| Recorded term          | What it means                                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DISTRIBUTOR_IDENTITY` | A distributor listing. Establishes which part this is, nothing more.                                     |
| `MANUFACTURER_MIRROR`  | A copy of a manufacturer document hosted elsewhere. Usable, but weaker than the manufacturer's own copy. |
| `PROJECT_GENERATOR`    | A document this project generated, such as a schematic or netlist export.                                |

### Identity state

| Recorded term | What it means                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VERIFIED`    | The exact orderable part has been confirmed against a source. |

### Source state

| Recorded term | What it means                                          |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `AVAILABLE`   | At least one document backing this line was retrieved. |

### Unit

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                      |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NONE`        | The value is not a physical quantity, so it carries no unit. Recorded as \`NONE\`. |
